column1: # BAL-169C (15 Oct 2026, account 4): glossed runs on Baluze 169 continuation canvases (btv1b9001488b, full/2400): c346, c345 (Chavigny f.169 letter),
# c301, c299, c298, c302 (Chavigny f.144 letter), read by my eye with 3x zooms of each target numeral (not blind: I knew key.tsv). Conventions as
# glossed_pairs.tsv (' = separate rising acute; : = two dots; = overbar; plain = no mark). Only tokens I could place under the gloss and whose mark I
# could settle; '65?' = a 65 whose acute I could not settle (c298 "le Masserati" L12, a dark stroke right of the 5; c302 "diray" L1, a stroke that may be
# the gloss's y descender) -- not scored. c347, c231, c224, c418: no 13: and no 65 under a gloss seen at overview scale (not read token by token).
# BAL-65G (15 Oct 2026, account 4): c297 (Chavigny f.144 letter, gate passed BAL-169C) and c232 (La Barde f.112; gate on c232 by this worker: 6/6
# placeable marked numerals give key.tsv -- 41' le "ailleurs", 10: les, 66' re, 86' avec, 40' la, 97= france "d'avec la france"). Eye at 2400 px with
# 2-3x zooms, not blind. Both 65 carry a separate rising stroke in cipher ink above the 5 (c232's is V-shaped: short down-stroke then long rising
# stroke, not touching the 5 or the gloss). The 17 in c232 "distraire" is unmarked (plain 17 = di here, logged, not a target). c344 is f.170r,
# clear text only (cipher on it is verso show-through): no glossed 65.
# BAL-65L (15 Oct 2026, account 4): Baluze 169 c180 (Bouthillier f.80 letter, f.88r) and Baluze 168 (btv1b9001503k) c439 (Chavigny f.212 letter) and
# c347 (Chavigny f.166 letter), full/2400, read by my eye with 3x zooms of each 65 (not blind). Only the 65 tokens are recorded here (all acute; the
# key-identity gate placements for the two 168 letters are in NOTES.md "## BAL-65L"). c179, c183, c184 and c187 below line 9: no 65 under a gloss.
# BAL-65C (15 Oct 2026, account 1, LANE DEFAULT-A1-1426-15): Baluze 168 (btv1b9001503k) c346 and c348 (Chavigny f.166 letter, the leaves either side of
# BAL-65L's c347), full/2400, my eye with 3x zooms of each 65 (not blind). Gate per canvas in NOTES.md "## BAL-65C" (c346 and c348 both PASS).
# c346: no 65 at all. c348 'satisfera' (41 70 77 f 21 65, 'quelle satisfera'): separate rising stroke above the 5 = 65'. c348 'reviendra' (66 82 95 4 65
# before 4 40 13 ... 'a la couronne de Suede'): no stroke in cipher ink above or touching the 6 or 5 at 2400 px and at max (region pct:41.6,75.4,12.5,4.5);
# one dot right of the 5's top, over the gap before the next crossed sign, not a stroke = plain by PREREG-BAL-302's rule. The gloss 'reviendra' is
# written left of the run (its underline ends before the 65), as other glosses on this leaf are; the run's five signs spell re vi en d ra.
# BAL-65D (15 Oct 2026, account 1, LANE DEFAULT-A1-1426-15): Baluze 168 (btv1b9001503k) c438 (f.212r) and c440 (f.213r), the f.212 Chavigny letter
# either side of BAL-65L's c439, full/2400, my eye with 3x zooms of each 65 (not blind). Gate per canvas in NOTES.md "## BAL-65D" (both PASS). On these
# leaves the gloss sits above its cipher. Every 65 under a gloss carries a separate rising acute above the 5 (65' ra); no plain 65 on either leaf, so
# no full-run row and no scorer re-run (PREREG-BAL-65D step 3). c438: 'transilvanie' (23: 16 u4 65' h ...), 'varadin' (80' 65' 17' h), 'courage'
# BAL-65E (15 Oct 2026, account 1, LANE DEFAULT-A1-1426-15): Baluze 168 (btv1b9001503k) c330 (f.158r), c331, c332 (f.158 Chavigny letter, survey.tsv
# row 168/158), full/2400, my eye with 3-8x zooms of each 65 (not blind). Gate per canvas in NOTES.md "## BAL-65E" (c330, c331 PASS; c332 carries no
# 65 at overview scale, no pairs). Gloss above its cipher. c330 'se relaschera' (K h 7' 66 40 p 9 31' 65): a separate rising stroke in cipher ink
# above the 6, crossing the gloss underline's tail, not touching the 65 = 65'. c331 'aura' (jl 52 4 x 65, 'il n'y aura'): separate rising stroke
# above-right of the 5, clear of the gloss 'plus' = 65'. c331 'd'esperance' (16' p 56' 65 h ii): at 2400 px and at max (region pct:61.5,27.0,7.5,4.0)
# one hairline of uniform grey tone runs from the gloss 'd' (of d'avoir) down to the top of the 6's loop, no gap, no darker segment, no separate stroke
# above the 6 or 5; a stroke continuous with a gloss letter is gloss (PREREG-BAL-302) = plain 65, full run below (units as placed under the gloss).
